title: Extracting Boundary Conformal Data from Periodic Non-Hermitian Critical Chains
abstract: Extracts nonunitary boundary conformal data (Affleck-Ludwig boundary entropy, negative g-ratios, complex boundary coefficients, Kramers-Wannier duality checks) from PERIODIC non-Hermitian critical chains using a short-range-entangled boundary-state preparation and its infrared-compatible left dual. Flagship demonstration: a PT-symmetric Ising model realizing the Yang-Lee CFT; also demonstrates a five-state Potts complex fixed point.
key_claims: Nonunitary boundary conformal data (Affleck-Ludwig entropy, negative g-ratios, complex boundary coefficients) extracted from PERIODIC non-Hermitian critical chains via prepared boundary states and their infrared-compatible left duals.

Flagship demo is a PT-symmetric Ising chain realizing the Yang-Lee CFT -- the exact M(2,5) fixed point the project's ED route could not reach at N<=16 (SIM-055, realizations at/beyond the PT-breaking edge).
Working on periodic chains with prepared boundary states sidesteps open-boundary PT-breaking pathologies -- plausibly the same obstruction that closed the project's ED route.
Five-state Potts complex-fixed-point demo connects loosely to the HYP-025 Potts lineage and to the complex-CFT sector mapped by PAPER-2026-130.
relevance_note: ACTIONABLE (deferred from scan #13, catalogued scan #14; the most actionable item for HYP-028). Demonstrates a working ALTERNATIVE route to Yang-Lee conformal data that does not require open boundaries or a non-Hermitian MERA: periodic PT-symmetric chains + left-dual boundary-state preparation. Concrete next steps this enables: (a) adapt the left-dual boundary-preparation construction as a pre-gate diagnostic or initialization for the planned non-Hermitian MERA; (b) evaluate it as a cheaper standalone route to Yang-Lee conformal data, potentially rescuing small-N numerics previously written off. SHARPENS (does not contradict) anchor 5 -- see anchor_contradiction.
anchor_contradiction: Anchor SHARPENING, not contradiction. Anchor 5 (HYP-028/SIM-055) states Yang-Lee M(2,5) is PT-inaccessible at exact-diag N<=16 and names non-Hermitian MERA as THE open route. The ED-inaccessibility finding stands (different method, different observables), but the framing should be updated to 'non-Hermitian MERA is ONE OF AT LEAST TWO routes': this paper's periodic-chain boundary-state technique extracts Yang-Lee conformal data without open boundaries and may rescue small-N numerics. Update the HYP-028 record's next-step framing accordingly.
